title: Alexei Ivanovitch Teleshoff

page_data.en:
Form No. 2

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. B. REC.
V.S. B.D. 530 Station,
10 - 2 - 31.
Date February 7, 19 31.

Subject (in full) Alexei Ivanovitch Teleshoff.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by W Duncan K.P.

Sir,

Information has been received to the effect
that Alexei Ivanovitch Teleshoff, residing at H138 Nanzing
Road, is a suspected Soviet Agent. He is 45 years of age,
married, Russian, who arrived in Shanghai about six months
ago from Tientsin, in which town his wife resides at 17
Paoshonli, Cousins Road. Before his arrival in this city
he was engaged in commercial pursuits, and it is said that
for some time he was employed on the C.E.R. in Manchuria
and during which time he made frequent visits to Mongolia.
He is employed locally as Manager of the "Centurion Printing
Co.," 10A Nanzing Road, and is said to hold some shares
in that concern. The above printing establishment is owned
by Mr. Vilensky and G. Deeki, suspected Soviet Agents.

（左侧手写批注：* / see also / 3.6.125）

G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

D. C. (C. & S. Branches)
Information. Copies have been
detached for the usual authorities.
J.M.G.
9:2:31.

（底部手写批注）

10:2:31.

日期：1931年2月7日。

主题（全称）阿列克谢·伊万诺维奇·捷列绍夫 (Alexei Ivanovitch Teleshoff)。

撰写人：D.S. 切列姆尚斯基 (Tcheremshansky)。呈送人：W. 邓肯 (Duncan) K.P.

先生：

接获情报称，居住于南京路 H138 号的阿列克谢·伊万诺维奇·捷列绍夫涉嫌为苏联特工。他现年45岁，已婚，俄国人，约六个月前从天津抵沪，其妻仍居住在天津 Cousin 路宝山里17号。在抵达本市之前，他从事商业活动，据称他曾在满洲的中东铁路 (C.E.R.) 任职一段时间，期间频繁前往蒙古。他在本地受雇为“百夫长印刷公司” (Centurion Printing Co.) 经理，公司地址位于南京路 10A 号，据说他在该公司持有一些股份。上述印刷机构由维连斯基先生 (Mr. Vilensky) 和 G. 迪基 (G. Deeki) 所有，此二人均涉嫌为苏联特工。

（左侧手写批注：* / 另见 / 3.6.125）

G. 切列姆尚斯基
D. S.

D. C. (刑事侦缉处各分支)
情报。副本已分送有关当局。
J.M.G.
9:2:31.

（底部手写批注）
归档

10:2:31.

Date.. March 27, 1930.
28 - 3 - 30.）

ct (in full) Centurion Printing Co.

Made by D.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by Tho Rubenstein C. D. 1.

Information has been received to the effect that
G. Dicky alias G. Deeki, an engineer by profession,
suspected Soviet Agent, formerly employed by the Chinese
Eastern Railway in Harbin, where he held an important
position, recently opened a printing establishment
under the name of "Centurion Printing Co." at 10A.
Nanzing Road. His partner in business is Mr. Vilensky,
formerly an employee of Kelly & Walsh Book Store,
Nanking Road, who is also a suspected Soviet Agent
and who was connected with the Soviet Consulate in
Shanghai, when it was in existence.
General printing will be carried on.
G. Dicky resides at 65 Avenue Dubail.

B. Maklaevsky.
D. S.

主题（全称）百夫长印刷公司 (Centurion Printing Co.)。

撰写人：D.S. 马克拉耶夫斯基 (Maklaevsky)。呈送人：Tho 鲁本斯坦 (Rubenstein) C. D. 1。

接获情报称，G. 迪基 (G. Dicky)，又名 G. 迪基 (G. Deeki)，职业为工程师，涉嫌为苏联特工，此前曾在哈尔滨的中东铁路任职，担任重要职位，最近在南京路 10A 号开设了一家名为“百夫长印刷公司”的印刷机构。他的商业伙伴是维连斯基先生 (Mr. Vilensky)，此人曾是南京路凯利与沃尔什书店 (Kelly & Walsh Book Store) 的雇员，也涉嫌为苏联特工，且在上海苏联领事馆存续期间与其有过关联。
公司将开展一般印刷业务。
G. 迪基居住于杜巴依路 (Avenue Dubail) 65 号。

B. 马克拉耶夫斯基。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Foreign Detective Station.
No. I. C. D. .330...
Date September 24, 1929
(in full) Arrival of Suspected Soviet Agent.
Made by D.S. Orfiannikoff. Forwarded by Thos Robertson C.D.I.
Sir,
The undermentioned Suspected Soviet Agent arrived
here from Harbin via Dairen on September 19, in the s.s.
"Hoten Maru."
Comrade Deeki-
Engineer by profession. He had an
important position in the Chinese
Eastern Railway, Harbin. In the
beginning of 1929, he was sent by
the U.S.S.R. authorities to attend
a Railway Conference in Berlin,
Germany and after one month of
absence from U.S.S.R. returned to
Moscow. It is alleged that whilst on
his way back to Harbin via Moscow,
he was arrested in the latter town
by G.P.U. agents for an alleged Anti-
Soviet activities and managed to
escape. There is a certain amount
of doubt to the authenticity of
this alleged arrest prevailing
among the local White Russian
Community. He resides at 255 Rue
Lafayette, house No. 24.
(批：Lin 24/9)
(签名)
V. Orfiannikoff
D. S.
A/D. C. I.

先生：
下述涉嫌苏联特工于9月19日乘“霍滕丸”号 (s.s. "Hoten Maru") 经大连从哈尔滨抵达此地。
迪基同志 (Comrade Deeki) -
职业为工程师。他在哈尔滨中东铁路担任重要职位。1929年初，他受苏联当局派遣前往德国柏林参加铁路会议，在离开苏联一个月后返回莫斯科。据称，在他经莫斯科返回哈尔滨途中，因被指控从事反苏活动而在莫斯科被国家政治保卫局 (G.P.U.) 特工逮捕，并设法逃脱。当地白俄社群中对这一所谓逮捕的真实性存在一定疑虑。他居住于拉斐德路 (Rue Lafayette) 255 号，24 号房屋。
(批：Lin 24/9)
(签名)
V. 奥尔菲安尼科夫
D. S.
A/D. C. I.
